steps.name: And a KRS company is configured for NIP "5261040828"
And a COMPANY user is authenticated for registry tests
And the registry user has emailVerified set to true
When the user performs a registry lookup for NIP "5261040828"
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"nip":"5261040828","regon":"012345678","krs":"0000123456","companyName":"E2E Testowa Firma Sp. z o.o.","companyType":"SP_ZOO","legalFormName":"SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ","street":"Marszałkowska","buildingNumber":"1","apartmentNumber":"10","city":"Warszawa","postalCode":"00-001","voivodeship":"MAZOWIECKIE","pkdMainCode":"62.01.Z","pkdMainDescription":"Działalność związana z oprogramo
And the lookup response should contain NIP "5261040828"
When the user confirms company data for NIP "5261040828"
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"companyDataId":8,"nip":"5261040828","companyName":"E2E Testowa Firma Sp. z o.o.","companyType":"SP_ZOO","activated":true,"accountStatus":"ACTIVE","message":"Company verified and activated"}
And the confirm response activated should be true
When the user requests their company data
Then the response status should be 200

expected 200; response body: {"id":8,"nip":"5261040828","regon":"012345678","krs":"0000123456","companyName":"E2E Testowa Firma Sp. z o.o.","companyType":"SP_ZOO","legalFormName":"SPÓŁKA Z OGRANICZONĄ ODPOWIEDZIALNOŚCIĄ","registeredAddress":{"city":"Warszawa","street":"Marszałkowska","building":"1","apartment":"10","postalCode":"00-001","voivodeship":"MAZOWIECKIE"},"pkdCodes":[{"code":"62.01.Z","isPrimary":true,"description":
And the company data response should contain NIP "5261040828"
